LESSON: KEEPING SAFE

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social 2.1.2 Keeping the By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners discuss wh
Topic 2.1.3: Keeping Safe

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Keeping Safe. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Keeping Safe
2. Practise Keeping Safe at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Keeping Safe

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Keeping Safe
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Keeping Safe. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Keeping Safe at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Keeping Safe at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Keeping Safe
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Keeping Safe. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Keeping Safe using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Keeping Safe in the examples.
2. Explain Keeping Safe to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Keeping Safe.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Keeping Safe using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Keeping Safe important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Using video clips, photographs and one safe and secure in school. pictures, learners identify how to keep safe and secure in school 93
2. Learners share ways of keeping safe and secure in school
3. Observe demonstrations and discussions on how to keep safe and secure in school from a resource person
4. In groups, learners to discuss the importance of keeping safe and secure at school
5. Learners develop rules on keeping safe and secure at school

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Keeping Safe
2. Practise Keeping Safe at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Keeping Safe

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
